name: Fetch.ai
rootCause: Fetch.ai suffered a $2.6 million loss when unauthorized access to its Binance account enabled hackers to liquidate assets at a significant undervalue on June 6, 2021. The incident led to legal action to trace and freeze stolen funds, but the technical details of the compromise remain undisclosed. Access to the Fetch.ai Binance account was gained via compromised private credentials, enabling unauthorized trading and asset transfer. The specific technical mechanism of the key compromise was not publicly disclosed.
